biggest_catch: Instant pay unlocks only after 3 verified shifts — your first shifts are paid twice-weekly or in 2–3 business days.
catches: On-Demand instant payments available only after you work three verified shifts (per Branch support page).
Instant Pay requires location tracking on during the shift — location off or missing means no instant pay.
Non-instant shifts pay within 2–3 business days after submitting your shift report; facility must approve the hours.
Per-shift eligibility is shift-by-shift; not every shift qualifies for instant pay.
Sending earnings to your own bank via debit card costs $2.99 or 2% — the free route is the Nursa Direct card.
You need an active nursing license/credential (RN, LPN/LVN, CNA, etc.).

eligibility: Active nursing credential (RN, LPN/LVN, CNA, etc.); comprehensive background check (free); smartphone.
maximize: Get your first three verified shifts done fast — Nursa's own setup page says automatic real-time payments only start after three verified shifts, so that's the unlock for same-day money. Keep your phone's location ON during every shift; the official FAQ says a missing location disqualifies the shift from Instant Pay and forces a manual report. Build a detailed profile with credentials, education, and references — Nursa's own site says facilities choose from those profiles, so a complete one gets you picked for more shifts. Use the free Nursa Direct card instead of debit-card transfers to your own bank, which cost $2.99 or 2% a pop.

steps: Download the Nursa app, create your clinician profile with credentials, education, and references.
Pick up PRN shifts posted by facilities; complete them with location on for auto-verification.
Submit/approve your Shift Report after the facility confirms hours.
Get paid instantly to Nursa Direct for eligible shifts (after your first three verified shifts), or twice-weekly / 2–3 business days otherwise.
timing: Nursa Direct: instant pay for eligible shifts as soon as the Shift Report is approved (unlocks after three verified shifts; location must be on). Non-instant shifts pay within 2–3 business days; twice-weekly option also available.
payout_value_note: variable per-task pay shown in-app before accepting; no fixed amount in official terms

who_pays: Nursa pays you per shift through Nursa Direct (powered by Branch) — facilities choose from worker profiles, so a thin profile gets fewer shifts.
who_qualifies: An active nursing credential (RN, LPN/LVN, CNA, etc.); a comprehensive background check (free); a smartphone.
work_available: Shifts are posted by facilities and they pick from worker profiles — not open to the general public; you need the credential first.
what_gets_accepted: Complete the shift and submit your Shift Report; the facility must approve the hours before pay is released.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees — the background check is free. Unpaid time: your first shifts don't get instant pay (it unlocks after 3 verified shifts). Sending earnings to your own bank via debit card costs $2.99 or 2% — the free route is the Nursa Direct card.
